text: We have already approved the specification.
The prototype has just arrived from the plant.
We have not tested the shelf life yet.
Have you finished the trial run yet?
I will not give a date before that test is finished.

I will give you the whole picture in two minutes, and then you can ask me anything. What is done. The specification has been approved, version four, by quality and by the plant, both signatures. The prototype has just arrived, two kilos, and it behaves exactly the way the document says it should. So the product, as an idea, works. Now the part that is not done, and there is only one that matters. We have not started the shelf life test. Twelve weeks, and before anybody asks: no, it cannot be made faster, no, we cannot run it in parallel with something else, and no, more people do not help. It is time in a warehouse. That is the whole test. So here is what I need from this room, and it is not patience, it is silence. Please do not give a launch date to any customer before that result is in. If we promise a date and the answer comes back negative, we do not lose twelve weeks. We lose the customer.

Every product that comes down to me arrives with a beautiful document written for two kilos, and then I am asked to make two tons of it. And people look at me as if that were the same thing with a bigger number in front. It is not. When the quantity changes, the time the mixture needs changes, because the middle of a two-ton batch does not behave like the middle of a bowl. The temperature changes for the same reason. And my line cannot stop. A laboratory can stop, look at something, think about it and start again. A production line that stops is a production line that has thrown away everything inside it. So what I ask for is always the same, and I have been asking for eleven years. One trial run in the real line before the specification is closed. One. It costs a day and a half and some material, and it saves three months of arguing about whose fault it is, which is a thing I have also done for eleven years and enjoy considerably less.
We have already approved the specification.
The prototype has just arrived from the plant.
We have not tested the shelf life yet.
Have you finished the trial run yet?
Finance has not signed the budget yet.
I will not give a date before that test is finished.
